links.outcome: Patient-rated comprehensibility of ChatGPT-simplified MRI reports by report complexity
links.effect: Simplicity of word choice and sentence structure rated "Agree" on average; patients better at knowing what the text was about (p = 0.001) and drawing correct conclusions (p = 0.013829) the more simplified the report.
links.quote: Participants reported being significantly better at knowing what the text was about (p = 0.001) and drawing the correct conclusions the more simplified the report of findings was (p = 0.013829).

screen.reason: The study empirically tests whether constraining LLM outputs to varying levels of complexity/simplification (simple vs. moderate vs. complex) impacts factual accuracy, patient comprehension, and potential harm.
